title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: AWS
providers.scope_notes: Covers Amazon Web Services (IAM, STS, IAM Identity Center, IAM Roles Anywhere, Amazon Bedrock). All features are available in every AWS account; SCPs and centralized root access require AWS Organizations, and Control Tower controls require AWS Control Tower.

controls.name: aws:SourceIp deny policy
controls.what: Identity policy or SCP that denies any request from outside listed CIDR ranges.
controls.setting: IAM policy / SCP with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp

controls.name: Maximum session duration
controls.what: Caps role session length at 1-12 hours (default 1 hour).
controls.setting: IAM > Roles > Edit > Maximum session duration; UpdateRole

controls.name: Revoke active sessions (AWSRevokeOlderSessions)
controls.what: Attaches a deny-all policy for sessions issued before now, invalidating existing temporary credentials for the role.
controls.setting: IAM > Roles > role > Revoke sessions tab

controls.name: aws:TokenIssueTime deny policy
controls.what: Deny policy that blocks temporary credentials issued before a chosen time; does not affect long-term keys.

controls.name: Role trust policy
controls.what: The trust policy decides which principals can assume a role; removing a principal stops new sessions for it.
controls.setting: IAM console > Roles > Trust relationships / aws iam update-assume-role-policy

controls.name: MFA condition in role trust policy (aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent)
controls.what: A trust policy can require that the caller authenticated with MFA before assuming the role.

no_control.what: Sessions of service-linked roles cannot be revoked.

controls_unknown: Whether long-term Bedrock API keys can be set to never expire, and their maximum lifetime.
Token format/prefix for Bedrock API keys (not documented on fetched pages).
Which CloudTrail field identifies the specific Bedrock API key on a request (key value is not logged).

auth_paths.name: IAM role temporary credentials (AWS STS AssumeRole)

authentication.summary: STS returns temporary credentials (ASIA... key ID, secret, session token) for a role. Caller must already hold AWS credentials and be trusted by the role trust policy.

federation.details: Role assumption from existing AWS credentials; external IdP federation is covered in aws-4 and aws-5.

ip_restriction.boundary: Not a setting: an identity policy or SCP that denies requests when aws:SourceIp is outside allowed ranges. It is evaluated on every signed API request. aws:SourceIp is absent for calls through VPC endpoints (use aws:VpcSourceIp) and SCPs do not cover the management account.

lifetime.summary: 15 min to role max (1-12 h, default 1 h); role chaining capped at 1 h

renewal.summary: Call AssumeRole again for new credentials.

administration.summary: Role trust policy controls who can assume; max session duration set per role; active sessions revoked with Revoke active sessions (AWSRevokeOlderSessions) or aws:TokenIssueTime deny.
administration.conditions: Service-linked role sessions cannot be revoked.

sso.details: Not tied to the IdP, but a role's trust policy can require MFA before the role can be assumed.

offboard.details: Role sessions belong to a role, not a user; already-issued sessions stay valid until they expire unless permissions are removed.

sso.ui: Role trust policy: add Condition Bool aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent = true on sts:AssumeRole

network.ui: Role identity policy with Deny * / NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp, or AWS Organizations console > Policies > Service control policies > Create policy (Deny * with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp) > attach to OU/account
network.cli: aws iam put-role-policy (inline deny) or aws organizations attach-policy

reads.ui: CloudTrail console > Trails > trail > Data events > Edit > enable S3 data events; then filter trail logs on eventName=GetObject (not in Event history)

token_format.notes: Temporary key ID ASIA... plus session token.

log_sources.name: AWS CloudTrail event history
log_sources.notes: On by default; 90 days of management events per Region; free. Data events (e.g. S3 GetObject) not included.

log_sources.name: CloudTrail trail / event data store
log_sources.notes: Needed for retention beyond 90 days; data events off by default and cost extra.

credential_id_fields.notes: Key ID used to sign the request; may be empty for security reasons.

lifecycle_events.notes: Logged in caller and role accounts; denied cross-account assumptions not logged in target account.

containment.steps: IAM > Roles > Revoke active sessions (AWSRevokeOlderSessions) or deny aws:TokenIssueTime before now; fix trust policy.
containment.notes: Applies to all sessions of the role, not just one; ~30 s propagation; not possible for service-linked roles.

calls.log_notes: All STS calls logged as management events; cannot be denied by policy.

calls.reveals: All IAM users, groups, roles, policies
All buckets owned by the account
calls.log_notes: Management/data classification not verified on fetched pages.

detections.title: AWS Console GetSigninToken Potential Abuse
detections.detects: GetSigninToken from a non-SSO user agent, used to turn CLI credentials into a console session.

detections.title: AWS Console GetSigninToken Potential Abuse
detections.detects: GetSigninToken from a user agent other than the console federation endpoint.

detections.title: AWS IMDS Credential Usage Outside Expected Services
detections.detects: EC2 instance role credentials used from a public IP outside expected AWS services, indicating stolen IMDS credentials.

detections.title: Malicious Usage Of IMDS Credentials Outside Of AWS Infrastructure
detections.detects: EC2 instance role session credentials used outside AWS infrastructure.

detections.title: AWS STS AssumeRole Misuse
detections.detects: Activity by an assumed-role session whose issuer is a role (role temporary credentials in use).

detections.title: AWS ECS Task Definition That Queries The Credential Endpoint
detections.detects: ECS task definitions whose command reads the container credentials endpoint ($AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI).

detections.title: IAM Assume Role Blocklist Ignored
detections.detects: An IAM user or federated user assumed a role on a blocklist (disabled by default).

detections.title: RoleAssumes by Multiple Useragents
detections.detects: Saved query: AssumeRole calls for one role and principal from more than one user agent in a day.

detections.title: AWS Potentially Stolen Service Role
detections.detects: Scheduled rule: a role assumed by an AWS service and also by a user within 24 hours.
